title: No mail from one external sender
symptom: User is not receiving emails from one external supplier
user_description: Our supplier says they've sent me three invoices this week but I haven't got any of them. Everyone else's emails arrive fine. Payment is due Friday!

options.text: Tell the supplier to use a different email address
options.why: This avoids the problem instead of finding why the mail is not arriving.

options.text: Turn off spam filtering for everyone
options.why: Exposes the whole company to spam and phishing to fix one sender.

options.text: Check Junk and the quarantine, run a message trace in the mail admin centre, check block lists and mail rules, and ask the sender for any bounce message
options.why: A message trace shows whether the mail arrived and what happened to it. Junk, quarantine, block lists and rules are the usual places it gets caught.
Her password has nothing to do with incoming mail from one sender.

hints: Did the emails reach the company at all?
Where can mail end up besides the inbox?
What can the sender tell you?
real_world_tip: Ask for the time each email was sent and the exact sender address. A message trace is much faster with those details.
